title: PHP Full Stack Developer
description:

* **React.js / Vue.js:** Working knowledge of at least one modern frontend framework.

* **REST APIs:** Experience in API development, integration, and third-party services.

* **Git & GitHub:** Experience with version control and collaborative development.

* **AJAX, JSON & jQuery:** Practical experience developing dynamic web applications.

* **Application Security:** Understanding of secure coding practices, authentication, and common web vulnerabilities.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, BCA, MCA, or a related field.

* Proven experience developing and deploying web applications.

* Strong understanding of OOP concepts, MVC architecture, and database management.

* Experience in debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting.

* Ability to work independently and deliver projects within deadlines.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Gemini is an added advantage.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with WordPress customization and custom plugin development.
* Experience with cPanel, or cloud hosting environments.
* Basic understanding of technical SEO and website optimization.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Gemini.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of assigned development tasks and projects.
* Delivery of clean, secure, and maintainable code.
* Efficient identification and resolution of bugs.
* Website and application performance improvements.
* Successful API integrations and production deployments.
* Effective collaboration and adherence to project timelines.

title: Lead / Senior SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are building the next generation of enterprise AI interoperability. As an **SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer**, you will pioneer our agentic AI roadmap — designing, building, and securing cross-platform agent networks that connect SAP's Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms over open agent communication protocols. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy pro-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
* Architect and implement end-to-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0.3.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout-resilient pipelines across SAP and non-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
* Configure end-to-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least-privilege access, token governance, and audit-ready agent call chains
* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
* Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection & Credential Aliases
* Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault-tolerance patterns relevant to multi-agent pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
* SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India)
description:
As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion.This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.  
  
  

### **Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities:**

* \*\*Technical Discovery & Solution Design\*\* - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
* \*\*Technical Account Ownership\*\* - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
* \*\*AI Architecture Advisory\*\* - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
* \*\*Evaluation & Proof of Value\*\* - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
* \*\*Enterprise Trust & Governance\*\* - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration\*\* - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
* \*\*Thought Leadership & Enablement\*\* - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
* \*\*Hands-on Solutions\*\* - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
* \*\*Rapid Prototyping\*\* - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
* \*\*Production Implementation\*\* - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall." Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
* \*\*Technical Advisory\*\* - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
* \*\*Travel\*\* - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
* Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
* Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
* Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals
* Experience planning and managing customer technical engagements, resolving blockers and coordinating customer and internal teams through evaluation, integration and adoption. A high degree of ownership, and the ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience communicating and translating complex AI/ML concepts for C-suite executives, IT leaders, engineering teams and non-technical business leaders while simultaneously working with customer engineering teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI safety, responsible AI practices, and implementing guardrails for LLM applications in regulated industries
* Experience creating and delivering technical enablement programs for sales teams, partners, or customer communities
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) in the context of AI deployments
* Experience architecting AI/ML solutions at scale in enterprise environments, including model deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience helping customers move from evaluation to live applications with measurable business value
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks (evals) assessing quality, latency, cost and reliability, and implementing enterprise-grade security guardrails for AI applications
* Hands-on experience building applications using AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem (Vector Databases, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, tool use and frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

description:

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

**Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab**

  

The ED&T Innovation Lab is Stryker’s one front door for internal, non-commercial problems across our five business units and central functions. We run focused prototype sprints on real problems with real users and approved data, show progress in weekly demos and decide on evidence: stop, refine or scale. A fast, well-reasoned no is a successful outcome. What scales moves to a named delivery owner with a full handoff package; the Lab never keeps a product long term, and never bypasses Enterprise Architecture, security, compliance or QMS governance. Our promise: “Bring us the problem. We’ll test the possibility. Together we scale what works.”

We are hiring Lead Full Stack Engineer in India as founding engineers of the Lab’s build team. This is a builder’s role with a scout’s curiosity: you will take ideas from a blank repo to a working demo in days or weeks, and spend real time researching, testing and experimenting with emerging technology so the Lab always knows what is possible next. You will report to the Senior Director, ED&T Innovation Lab, and work in a small, hands-on team across the US and India.

**What you will do:**

* Own full-stack prototypes from first commit to working demo in 2–8-week sprints, spanning front end, APIs, services, data, cloud deployment and AI.
* Bring ideas to life through minimally functional prototypes tested by real users on real business problems with approved data, showcasing progress in weekly demos.
* Build AI-powered solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, tool calling, copilots, automation, and intelligent document and email processing.
* Explore emerging technologies—from AI and agents to automation, digital twins and quantum—and run time-boxed experiments, proofs of concept and technology comparisons to separate capability from hype.
* Shape technical direction for your prototypes: define architecture, break down delivery, assess existing Stryker capabilities for reuse and make evidence-based build-or-kill decisions, recognising a well-reasoned no as a successful outcome.
* Accelerate the Lab’s engineering foundations with reusable starter kits, components, templates, CI/CD pipelines and sandbox patterns, while maintaining clean code, targeted testing, secure defaults and practical documentation.
* Stay hands-on while reviewing code, pairing with and mentoring engineers, and partnering with the Lab leader to shape technical direction.
* Partner with business stakeholders and Business Innovation Partners to translate problems into buildable scope, clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria.
* Turn experimentation into shared insight through concise write-ups, demos, contributions to the Lab’s quarterly innovation radar for ED&T leadership and your own experiment ideas; capture what worked, what did not, and the cost and effort to scale.

thousands of live contracts. Customer communications, where essential customer

agent information and interactions are managed consistently across products and channels.

New business and policy issuance, where an application must move accurately from initial

Transactional integrity, idempotency and reconciliation as daily practice rather than interview
